verdict.rationale: The speech-to-text convert API reference says the service accepts hosted audio/video files and YouTube, TikTok and other video-hosting URLs. That means the service fetches remote media itself, so the developer does not upload it. The evidence is a single short parameter description, with no detail on signed or authenticated URLs and no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of signed/pre-signed URL support, the parameter name, size and format limits for URL ingestion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a public or signed URL and the service fetches and transcribes the recording without my uploading it

citations.quote: Supports hosted video or audio files, YouTube video URLs, TikTok video URLs, and other video hosting services.
